untertitel: A snapshot freezes the state of a target. It only takes up space once files change afterwards. You can restore individual files or roll back an entire target.
ziel_erklaerung: System = the operating system partition (admin only). Shares = your data.
kein_ziel: There is no snapshot target yet. Create a share first.
belegung_warnung: The data partition is {prozent} % full. From 95 % on, no more snapshots are created – please free up space or delete old snapshots.
belegung_gestoppt: The data partition is {prozent} % full. Snapshot creation is paused until space is available again.
erzeugen_beschreibung_erklaerung: Free text so you can recognize the version later, e.g. “before cleanup”.
keine: There is no snapshot for this target yet.
loeschen_frage: Delete snapshot from {zeit}? Files that only exist there will be gone afterwards.
durchsuchen_erklaerung: Check files or folders and restore them to the share. The snapshot itself stays unchanged.
durchsuchen_fehl: The folder could not be read.
zurueckholen_erklaerung: The selected entries are copied from the snapshot into the share. Existing files with the same name stay unchanged – unless you choose “Replace existing” below.
zurueckholen_ersetzen_erklaerung: Off: if a file with the same name already exists at the destination, the restore stops with a notice. On: the file at the destination is replaced by the snapshot version – this is how you revert a changed file to its old version.
zurueckholen_kein_recht: You are not allowed to write to this share. You can view the snapshot but not restore anything – ask the admin.
zurueckholen_ziel_erklaerung: Relative to the share, empty = root. For example “Fotos/2025”. Missing folders are created.
zurueckrollen_frage1: Roll back share “{name}” to the state from {zeit}? Everything changed since then will disappear from the share.
zurueckrollen_erklaerung: A safety snapshot of the current state is created automatically first – so you can go back. The share is briefly unavailable during the process.
zurueckrollen_tippen: Type the share name to confirm
zurueckrollen_tippen_erklaerung: The button is enabled only once “{name}” is entered here.
zurueckrollen_fertig: The share has been rolled back.
system_titel: System versions in the boot menu
system_erklaerung: Before and after every update, the NAS creates snapshots of the system. They appear in the boot menu at power-on under “FAH-NAS Schnappschüsse”.
system_anleitung: 1. Restart the NAS and choose the entry with the desired version in the boot menu. 2. Check that everything works. 3. Click “Use at next boot” here to make the version permanent. Without step 3, the NAS boots the previous version again next time.
startmenue_laden_fehl: The boot menu entries could not be read.
startmenue_keine: No system snapshots in the boot menu yet.
standard_frage: Use this system version permanently from the next boot on?
standard_warnung: Warning: the current system version will be replaced at the next boot. All system changes since the selected version (updates, system settings) will be lost. Your data in the shares is not affected. The switch only takes effect after a restart.
standard_gesetzt: This version will be used at the next boot. Restart the NAS to switch.
plan_erklaerung: Regular snapshots per target. Switch on each interval and set how many snapshots to keep – the retention period follows. Older snapshots are deleted automatically.
plan_stuendlich_erklaerung: One version every full hour. Good for folders with a lot of activity.
plan_behalten_erklaerung: Count = how many snapshots of this interval are kept; older ones are deleted. Period = how far back they reach. Change one and the other follows.
plan_zahl_fehler: Please enter a whole number from 1 to 1000.
plan_reicht_keiner: No interval on – only manual snapshots.
plan_pre_post_erklaerung: Every system update creates a before/after pair. This many pairs are kept.
